references.text: The description of the Kohathite clans and their service in the sanctuary, which forms the basis for the census in 4:37.
God's command to Moses to count the Kohathites between the ages of 30 and 50, a task this census completes.
The specific duty of the Kohathites to carry the holy objects in the tabernacle.
The actual counting of the Kohathites that is summarized in verse 37.
A concluding summary stating that Moses counted the Levites according to the Lord's command, parallel to verse 37.
Reference to the Israelites breaking camp according to the Lord's command through Moses, using the same expression 'by the word of the Lord through Moses'.
Kohath is mentioned as the son of Levi and the ancestor of the Kohathites who are counted here.
A previous census of the Levites carried out by Moses and Aaron according to the Lord's command, using the same wording.
